# Version 1.0.1

We are releasing version `v1.0.1` of Apollo 3, a small patch release with a fix
and documentation updates since `v1.0.0`.

<!-- truncate -->

## Bug fixes

- In local editing, fetching sequence now works for assemblies that use
  reference name aliases.
- The Apollo and JBrowse versions shown in the documentation's tutorials and
  installation examples are now kept up to date with each release.

## For more information

For more details on any of the changes mentioned as well as many more changes
that have been made, please reference the associated GitHub issues.

- Make sure versions mentioned in docs stay up to date by @garrettjstevens in
  https://github.com/GMOD/Apollo3/pull/798

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/GMOD/Apollo3/compare/v1.0.0...v1.0.1
